LanguageData.RMush_PsychedelicExperience.stages.0.des: Colors and shapes feel wonderfully alive. Everything seems strangely connected.
LanguageData.RMush_PsychedelicExperience.stages.1.des: The world feels soft and distant. For a while, everyday worries seem far away.
LanguageData.RMush_PsychedelicExperience.stages.2.des: Nothing feels quite real, and every strange shape seems threatening. I want this to stop.
